title: loadWorkspace Promise.all fails entirely if any single channel fails to fetch messages
description: In EnabledWorkspace.tsx loadWorkspace(), listMessages is called eagerly on all channels in a single un-isolated Promise.all. A transient failure or permission error on one channel causes the entire workspace to crash with 'Workspace failed to load'.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): CONFIRMED in code.

`loadWorkspace` uses `Promise.all` over `listMessages` for every channel. One rejected `listMessages` rejects the whole batch and hits the outer catch (“Workspace failed to load”), so no bots/channels/messages apply even though earlier fetches succeeded. Tasks/computer already use `.catch(() => …)` but channel messages do not.

Fix: per-channel `.catch` (empty list + surface partial error), or `Promise.allSettled`, and still render roster.
